question: What change occurs in the network of kalās through the arising of the twelve vowels and re-entry?
premises: The net of kalās becomes diminished through the arising of the twelve vowels.
Then, on entry, sixteen kalās are gathered.
This gathering makes the state bright.
inference: The practice moves from diminution of kalās to a luminous reconstitution through sixteen gathered kalās.
uncertainties: The technical identity of the kalās here is not fully explained in the verse.
plain_english: Through the arising of the twelve vowels the net of kalās becomes diminished; then, on entry, he becomes bright with the sixteen kalās gathered together.
